ctx.x: I think Earl Fuller, to my knowledge, made one of the first recordings using -- he said -- he had j-a-z-z or j-a-s-s -- the Dixieland Jazz Band used j-a-s-s- I think. The j-a-z-z came later, but it was originally j-a-s-s. Yeah.
Well, that's great. Well, after your school days of the university, then you -- were you still in your home town -- went back to your home town of Springfield?
